title: I-Kyber ithola uxhaso lwamadola ayizigidi ezi-5 lokwakha ingqalasizinda ezokwenza ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenzisane nemishini ngesikhathi sangempela
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
EParis naseSan Francisco, ziyi-10 kuJuni 2026. Ngemva kokusebenza ngasese, i-Kyber isiphumela obala ngoxhaso lokuqala lwamadola ayizigidi ezi-5. I-Lightspeed Venture Partners ihole lo mzuliswano wokuxhasa, kwatshala imali ne-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures. I-Kyber yasungulwa nguJean-Baptiste Kempf, unjiniyela owakha isidlali se-VLC ne-FFmpeg. Yakha ingqalasizinda enekhodi evulekile exhumanisa abantu nama-ejenti obuhlakani bokwenziwa namarobhothi, amadroni nezinhlelo ezizisebenzelayo. Lokhu kuxhumana kwenzeka ngesikhathi sangempela, noma ukuphi emhlabeni, cishe kungabi nakubambezeleka.

Isisekelo ebesishoda ukuze ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenze emishinini

Kunobuchwepheshe abantu abaningi abangakaze bazihluphe ngokucabanga ngabo. Abunayo indawo umsebenzisi asebenzisana nabo kuyo. Busebenza buthule nje, kuze kube ngelinye ilanga umhlaba ungasakwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwabo.

UJean-Baptiste Kempf usechithe iminyaka engamashumi amabili akha lolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe. Waqala nge-VLC, isidlali semidiya esifakwe buthule emishinini eyizigidigidi ezine. Kwalandela i-FFmpeg, iqoqo lamakhodekhi elisebenza cishe kuzo zonke izinkundla zamavidiyo emhlabeni. Kokubili sekuyingxenye ebalulekile yengqalasizinda ye-inthanethi, nakuba kungabonakali.

Yilowo mbono futhi oyisisekelo se-Kyber. Kulokhu usetshenziswa enkundleni entsha: emhlabeni esiphila kuwo.

Njengoba ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busuka ezikrinini bungena emarobhothini, emadronini, ezinhlelweni zokuhlinza nasezimotweni ezizishayelayo, kuvela inselele efanayo kuzo zonke lezi zinhlelo: ukusebenzisana ngesikhathi sangempela. Irobhothi alikwazi ukuma lilinde kuqoqeke idatha. Idroni ayinakuphendula sekwephuzile. Umshini owulawula ukude kufanele usabele ngokushesha njengalapho uphambi kwakho.

Kuze kube manje, ibingekho ingqalasizinda ebingenza lokhu kwenzeke.

Ukubambezeleka kuyinkinga enkulu. I-Kyber iyixazulula kanjani?

Iningi lezinhlelo ezisebenza ngesikhathi sangempela namuhla lisebenzisa i-WebRTC, iphrothokholi eyakhelwa izingcingo zevidiyo. Uma impendulo ibambezeleka ngama-200 ms, imoto elawulwa ukude isuke isidlule ngamamitha lapho obeyilawula ebeqonde ukuyimisa khona. Uma ukubambezeleka kungama-8 ms, njengoba i-Kyber ikwenza kwenzeke, umshini usabela kube sengathi uyisandiso salowo owulawulayo.

I-Kyber ihlinzeka nge-SDK eyodwa evumelanisa konke okudingekayo ukuze imishini ilawulwe ngesikhathi sangempela:

  • Ividiyo, umsindo, idatha yezinzwa nemiyalo yokulawula kuvumelaniswa ngewashi elilodwa
  • Ukubambezeleka kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni kungehla kufike kuma-8 ms, kube kuncane kakhulu ukuba umuntu akuzwe
  • Ikhodi eyisisekelo ivulekile, kanti uhlelo lungasetshenziswa kumaseva asendaweni yenkampani, kwasefwini noma kuhlanganiswe kokubili

Yakhelwe amarobhothi, i-XR, amadroni, izimoto ezizishayelayo, ama-ejenti obuhlakani bokwenziwa, ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha ukude nezinhlelo zesizukulwane esilandelayo zobuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emishinini.

Izinkampani ezihamba phambili kwezokuvikela, kwezokuxhumana ngocingo, kwezamarobhothi nakwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa sezisebenzisa i-Kyber kwezohwebo. Ithimba le-Kyber linonjiniyela abangama-26 abangochwepheshe kwezamarobhothi, kumanethiwekhi, ekucutshungulweni kwedatha ngokubambezeleka okuncane nasengqalasizindeni yevidiyo.

Abatshalizimali abasekela umbono we-Kyber

I-Lightspeed Venture Partners, enye yezinkampani ezihamba phambili emhlabeni ekutshaleni imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa, ihole umzuliswano woxhaso lokuqala lwamadola ayizigidi ezi-5. I-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures nazo zitshale imali kulo mzuliswano.

“Ngesikhathi sitshala imali kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa nakwezamarobhothi, sasilokhu sibona into efanayo: amamodeli ayehlakanipha ngokwengeziwe, kodwa ingqalasizinda ewaxhumanisa nomhlaba esiphila kuwo yayingahambisani naleyo ntuthuko. Sabe sesihlolisisa izisekelo zalobu buchwepheshe ukuze sithole ukuthi yini ngempela eyayishoda. Kuzo zonke izixazululo esazithola, i-Kyber ingenye esagculisa kakhulu.” — U-Antoine Moyroud, uzakwethu e-Lightspeed Venture Partners

Yini elandelayo?

Lolu xhaso luzosiza i-Kyber isheshise ukwakha ungqimba lwamaphrothokholi oluxhumanisa abantu nama-ejenti obuhlakani bokwenziwa nemishini ngesikhathi sangempela. Lokhu kuthinta yonke imikhakha lapho izinhlelo ezizisebenzelayo ziya ngokuya zibaluleka khona.

UJean-Baptiste Kempf ukubeka kanje:

“Eminyakeni ezayo, imishini eminingi ezisebenzelayo izohamba izindawana ngezindawo. I-Kyber izokhiqiza isofthiwe eyisisekelo yokwakha le mishini, ukuyilawula nokuyiqapha ngesikhathi sangempela.”

Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emishinini buthuthuka ngesivinini. Imishini iya ihlakanipha. Manje sekumele nengqalasizinda ihambisane nalelo jubane.

Funda kabanzi ku-kyber.tech

Mayelana ne-Kyber

I-Kyber yasungulwa eParis nguJean-Baptiste Kempf, unjiniyela owakha i-VLC ne-FFmpeg. Yakha ingqalasizinda enekhodi evulekile eyenza ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenzisane nemishini ngesikhathi sangempela. Isekelwa yi-Lightspeed Venture Partners, i-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures.

Mayelana ne-Lightspeed Venture Partners

I-Lightspeed iyinkampani esebenza emhlabeni wonke etshala imali ezinkampanini ezisezigabeni ezihlukahlukene zokukhula. Iphethe izimpahla zenani elingaphezu kwamadola ayizigidigidi ezingama-50. Kusukela ngo-2000, i-Lightspeed isisekele ezinye zezinkampani ezihamba phambili emhlabeni ngokusungula izinto ezintsha, okubalwa kuzo i-Anthropic, i-Mistral, i-Snap ne-Wiz.

Isizindalwazi: lightspeedhq.com

Mayelana ne-Ovni Capital

I-Ovni Capital yinkampani yaseFrance etshala imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa. Isekela osomabhizinisi abakha ubuchwepheshe obusha obusemqoka, kusukela kobudinga ucwaningo olujulile kuya kobengqalasizinda.

Isizindalwazi: ovni.capital

Mayelana ne-Kima Ventures

I-Kima Ventures yasungulwa nguXavier Niel. Iphakathi kwezinkampani zaseYurophu ezimatasa kakhulu ngokutshala imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa. Isekela abasunguli bezinkampani zobuchwepheshe abanemigomo emikhulu kusukela zisanda kuqala.

Isizindalwazi: https://www.kimaventures.com

Mayelana ne-Les Echos

I-Les Echos yiphephandaba lansuku zonke elihamba phambili eFrance ngezindaba zamabhizinisi nezezimali. Libika izindaba zakamuva ngezomnotho, ezobuchwepheshe nokusungulwa kwezinto ezintsha.

Isizindalwazi: lesechos.fr
